definitions.mixedCofactor: bilinear a b c d 1 1 - bilinear a b c d 1 0 - bilinear a b c d 0 1 + bilinear a b c d 0 0
definitions.localCorrection: bilinear a b c d x y - 2*x*y*mixedCofactor a b c d
definitions.phase: fun s => if p s then -P s else P s
definitions.inversionPhase: product_i:Fin n product_l in Ioi i (if sigma i < sigma l then (1:R) else -1)

obligations.local_mixed_cofactor: forall a b c d:R, mixedCofactor a b c d = d
obligations.local_xy_correction: forall a b c d x y:R, localCorrection a b c d x y = a + b*x + c*y - d*x*y
obligations.phase_involution: forall S:Type p:S->Prop [DecidablePred p] P:S->R, phase p (phase p P) = P
obligations.phase_commute: forall S:Type p q:S->Prop [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] P:S->R, phase p (phase q P) = phase q (phase p P)
obligations.inversion_phase_eq_signCoeff: forall n:Nat sigma:Equiv.Perm(Fin n), (inversionPhase sigma:R) = CollisionDeterminantBridge.signCoeff sigma
obligations.corrected_signed_weight: forall n:Nat b:Matrix(Fin n)(Fin n)R sigma:Equiv.Perm(Fin n), (inversionPhase sigma:R) * (CollisionDeterminantBridge.signCoeff sigma * CollisionDeterminantBridge.weight b sigma) = CollisionDeterminantBridge.weight b sigma
obligations.corrected_signed_sum: forall n:Nat b:Matrix(Fin n)(Fin n)R, sum_sigma ((inversionPhase sigma:R) * (CollisionDeterminantBridge.signCoeff sigma * CollisionDeterminantBridge.weight b sigma)) = sum_sigma CollisionDeterminantBridge.weight b sigma
